setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 loops eight steps: pattern 1 plays C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) on steps 1 to 4, and pattern 2 adds trigs on steps 5 and 7. Merge Shape has Foundation on with pattern 1 as the anchor, and Harmony Ensemble has an enabled group holding C, E and G. The Structure screen is open with Markers on Anchors, so each anchor note is a marker. Playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent to the right of Anchors and press K3. Markers reads EVERY 4 and the footer says APPLIED: steps 1, 5, 9 and so on are the markers, whatever plays there.
steps.title: Set Markers to Every 4

steps.caption: Press Play, then Stop. Only the marker steps snap to the group, so look at the MIDI strip: step 1 plays 60 and step 5 plays 60 too, because its D snaps to C, while steps 2, 3 and 4 are no longer markers and keep their own notes 62, 64 and 65. Step 7 adds another 60. Each loop sounds 60, 62, 64, 65, 60, 60.
steps.title: Markers 1 and 5 snap to the chord
